facts.business: Rasandik Engineering Industries India Limited manufactures sheet metal components, dies & tools, tailor welded blanks, and electric vehicles under the SAMRAT brand for automotive and industrial customers.
key_risks: Technological Risk: Rapid evolution in EV technology may require ongoing capital investment.
Policy Risk: Changes in government incentives or EV policies could impact demand.
Supply Chain Risk: Disruptions in sourcing components or logistics could affect production.
Market Risk: Demand fluctuations and pricing pressures in both EV and fabrication segments.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were placed before the Audit Committee for prior approval, and thereafter before the Board of Directors, wherever required, in accordance with applicable provisions. Details are disclosed in the Notes to the Financial Statements as per Ind AS 24.
